name: leathercad
description: Desktop application for designing leathercraft patterns that print at exact 1:1 scale
author: cornelisp

scripts.depcruise:graph: depcruise packages apps --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph.svg
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm depcruise && pnpm test
scripts.test:visual: node -e "console.error('Not implemented until slice 2.3 (Canvas2D backend). See docs/testing.md'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.bench: node -e "console.error('Not implemented until slice 1.9 (offsetting). See docs/testing.md'); process.exit(1)"
